# MonotonicUuid

A generator of version 7 UUIDs that are strictly increasing, even within one millisecond.

```rux
pub struct MonotonicUuid {
    // private fields
}
```

The format guarantees ordering only between milliseconds; two UUIDs made in the same one have random tails
and may sort either way. This closes that by remembering the last value it produced: when the clock has not
advanced, it increments the previous UUID instead of drawing a fresh one, so every value it returns is
strictly greater than the last.
A caller owns one of these rather than sharing a global, so two components generating identifiers do not
serialize against each other or interleave into one sequence.
